verdict.rationale: Railway's own site says you can 'Rollback to any previous version instantly when something breaks', which matches the story's core of reverting a service to any prior version quickly. This rests on a single marketing line with no detailed docs or hands-on confirmation, and 'one click' is only implied by 'instantly'. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party rollback documentation, explicit confirmation of a one-click UI action, independent or hands-on corroboration.
